name: Ro
headline: Turn Marriott’s booking data into stays that come back.
saw: Across a hotel group of Marriott’s size, the offer a guest sees is usually built for a broad segment, such as business travellers or families, and every guest in that segment receives the same message regardless of how they actually book.

Booking history, length of stay, room type, and whether a guest ever books a second time are the strongest signals you have for the next stay and the next cancellation. Today that signal sits in analytics, not in the message the guest receives.
Upsell, cross-sell and retention campaigns are typically built by hand, per segment, per month. The guest who is about to lapse this week gets the same offer as everyone else, or none at all.
help_intro: Three places where an AI that decides per customer, not per segment, pays for itself in the first quarter.

cases.head: Stop the lapse before it happens
cases.text: A churn score per customer from booking gaps, lapsed stays and service contacts. The right offer, channel and moment for each guest, tested continuously across your brands.
cases.kpi_label: lower churn, measured at Flytxt telecom clients

cases.head: Offer the stay that fits each guest
cases.text: Next best room, rate and add-on per customer, triggered by how they book and what they already bought. No blanket mails to guests who would book anyway.
cases.kpi_label: conversion vs untargeted campaigns, Tier-1 African MNO

cases.head: Keep every guest booking between stays
cases.text: Personal nudges across email and owned channels, orchestrated so each guest has a reason to engage again between stays, decided per customer.
cases.kpi_label: streaming activity at an OTT client
